crossRefs.note: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt…
At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in…
The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore…

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
translations.bsb: So Daniel went in and asked the king to give him some time, so that he could give him the interpretation.
translations.kjv: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
translations.asv: And Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
